investment_strategy: Constructive-but-selective AI-stack barbell. With low volatility (VIX ~13.5) and strong index momentum, we lean into quality growth in AI platforms and infrastructure while sizing high-beta chip exposures prudently given 4.18% 10Y yields and policy/power constraints. We diversify across the AI stack—platforms (MSFT, GOOGL), equipment (ASML), accelerators (NVDA), and memory (MU)—to capture AI capex and enterprise adoption while managing export-control and antitrust risks. Position sizing favors lower-volatility, cash-generative leaders, and limits high-risk names to avoid drawdowns if policy or power bottlenecks hit sentiment.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Emphasis on lower volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, and STRONG_BUY/BUY consensus; diversified across AI stack to balance export-control, antitrust, and power-constraint risks; larger weights to cash-generative platforms, smaller to high-beta semis.
